summary: Frontend-only migration verification of GarlicLedger Pro (Expo + react-native-web on port 3000). All 6 requested flows pass: web app loads, dashboard renders 'My Garlic Business', all 5 bottom tabs navigate, new-sale flow computes total ₹500, remaining ₹300, status 'Partial', save returns to dashboard which updates today-sales=₹500 and total-pending=₹300, Pending tab lists Ramesh, More menu shows all 6 rows and settings navigates to /settings. Zero uncaught JS errors / console errors observed.

issues: sale-status testid element contains concatenated text ('Remaining₹300PartialThis customer will be added...') because the testID is on a wrapper View; the visible 'Partial' badge is a child. Functional but the wrapper testid would be cleaner if placed on the badge span.

critical_code_review_comments: backend supervisor is FATAL as expected (no backend by design); consider removing the backend supervisor entry to reduce noise.
sale-status testid on wrapper View aggregates unrelated text; move testid onto the status badge <Text> for cleaner semantics/testing.
seed_data_creation: Created one sale via UI: customer 'Ramesh', qty 10, price 50, received 200 (persisted to AsyncStorage/IndexedDB in browser only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Metro first bundle build takes ~30s; use wait_for_selector with 60-90s timeout on data-testids instead of networkidle. Backend supervisor being FATAL is expected — app has no backend. All primary flows verified working.
